player_intent: Use native direction-specific pistol arms in the main game with a rigid held weapon, correct target finger closure and bounded presentation aim.
acceptance_rule: The main saved profile enables source_pistol_attachment and disables legacy_pistol_upper_body. Pistol families use native ready and strafe clips, stopped arm IK, exact animated trigger-palm attachment and declared finger closure. A single bounded upper-body group aim preserves relative arm geometry. Main-scene movement, accepted shots and reload must retain attachment. This is a Godot adaptation, not proof of recovered original held-helper parenting or one-for-one engine behavior.

nodes.role: Consumes the saved pistol-only presentation policy

must_not_change: Camera aim and authoritative shots/damage/ammo/reload duration
Original animation resources and selected character
Rifle, shotgun and sniper presentation policies
Held ISO helper interpretation until its parent is recovered
visual_check: Inspect main-scene standing/crouched early/middle/late forward, left and right movement/fire, idle and reload. Confirm actual selected model, compact source right pose, independent left arm where authored, closed trigger fingers, stable gun contact and accepted-fire bore. Numerical contact is not a visual-quality pass.

system_delta.reason: The previous main profile replaced source arms with legacy upper poses. The isolated no-layer candidate left missing finger and aim inputs. A pistol-only adaptation uses existing owners while preserving source arm geometry and other weapon families.

current.system: Native directional clips overwritten by legacy upper-body and two-arm fitting

candidate.system: Pistol-only native body, rigid palm mount, bounded group aiming and explicit finger closure
